label: Recurrent / metastatic HNSCC, first-line systemic therapy
condition: Head and Neck Squamous Cell Carcinoma
source_note: Encoded from a published protocol's Inclusion/Exclusion criteria. This is a SCREENING AID, not an eligibility determination: many criteria cannot be assessed by interview (PD-L1 CPS, RECIST measurability, organ function) and are marked accordingly.

fields.label: Age
fields.question: How old are you?
fields.help: Must be 18 or older on the day consent is signed.

fields.label: Pathology-confirmed diagnosis
fields.question: Has your diagnosis of head and neck squamous cell carcinoma been confirmed by a biopsy or pathology report?

fields.label: Primary tumour site
fields.question: Where is the primary tumour?
fields.help: Paranasal sinus and nasopharynx are excluded regardless of histology.

fields.label: HPV status
fields.question: If the primary is in the oropharynx, do you know your HPV status?

fields.label: Disease setting
fields.question: Is your disease recurrent or metastatic, or is it still only locally advanced?

fields.label: Prior systemic therapy for recurrent/metastatic disease
fields.question: Have you had any systemic therapy since the cancer came back or spread?
fields.help: This protocol requires that there has been none.

fields.label: Months since systemic therapy completed (adjuvant/definitive)
fields.question: If you had chemotherapy or other systemic therapy as part of earlier curative-intent treatment, how many months ago did it finish?

fields.label: Tumour tissue available
fields.question: Is there an archived tumour sample available, or would you be willing to have a biopsy at screening?
fields.help: Either archived tissue or willingness to biopsy is required.

fields.label: Measurable disease (RECIST 1.1)
fields.question: Has your care team said you have measurable disease?
fields.help: Assessed on imaging by the study team, not by interview.

fields.label: ECOG performance status
fields.question: Do you know your ECOG performance status? It runs from 0 (fully active) to 4 (fully disabled).

fields.label: Disease suitable for curative-intent local therapy
fields.question: Has your care team said the disease could still be treated with local therapy given with curative intent, such as surgery or radiation?
fields.help: If so, this protocol excludes you.

fields.label: Prior anti-TGFβ therapy
fields.question: Have you ever had a treatment that targets TGF-beta?

fields.label: Prior anti-EGFR antibody
fields.question: Have you had an antibody treatment targeting EGFR, such as cetuximab or panitumumab?
fields.help: Radiosensitising use and use within curative multimodal treatment do not count.

fields.label: Grade ≥2 reaction to anti-EGFR therapy
fields.question: Have you had a significant intolerance or allergic reaction to an anti-EGFR treatment, or to other murine proteins?

fields.label: Months since immune checkpoint inhibitor
fields.question: If you have had an immune checkpoint inhibitor such as pembrolizumab or nivolumab, how many months ago did it finish?

fields.label: Progression within 6 months of curative systemic therapy
fields.question: Did the cancer progress within 6 months of finishing systemic therapy given with curative intent?

fields.label: Expected survival (months)
fields.question: Has your care team discussed an expected prognosis? If so, roughly how many months?
fields.help: Must be at least 3 months. It is fine to skip this one.

fields.label: Active CNS metastases or leptomeningeal disease
fields.question: Do you have active metastases in the brain or spine, or a history of carcinomatous meningitis?

fields.label: Major bleeding
fields.question: Have you had a major bleeding episode in the last 4 weeks, or do you have active major bleeding?

fields.label: Other investigational drug recently
fields.question: Have you taken another investigational drug in the last 4 weeks, or within 5 half-lives of it?

fields.label: Active autoimmune disease on systemic treatment
fields.question: Do you have an autoimmune condition that has needed systemic treatment in the past 2 years?

fields.label: Active hepatitis B
fields.question: Do you have chronic hepatitis B that is active and is not currently controlled with antiviral treatment?

fields.label: Untreated or detectable hepatitis C
fields.question: Have you had hepatitis C that has not been cured, or that is still detectable?

fields.label: Known HIV
fields.question: Do you have HIV?

fields.label: Organ or stem-cell transplant requiring immunosuppression
fields.question: Have you had an organ or stem-cell transplant that requires you to take immunosuppressive medicine?

fields.label: Another malignancy in the last 2 years
fields.question: Have you been diagnosed or treated for another cancer in the last 2 years?
fields.help: Curatively treated skin cancer, in situ cervical or breast cancer, and low-risk early prostate cancer do not count.

fields.label: Corticosteroids or immunosuppressants recently
fields.question: In the last week, have you taken steroids by mouth (more than 10 mg prednisone a day) or another immunosuppressive medicine?
fields.help: Topical, inhaled, nasal and eye steroids do not count.

fields.label: Live vaccine in the last 4 weeks
fields.question: Have you had a live or live-attenuated vaccine in the last 4 weeks?

rules.text: Age 18 or older on the day consent is signed
Histologically or cytologically confirmed disease
Primary in oral cavity, hypopharynx, larynx or oropharynx
Oropharyngeal primaries must be HPV-negative
Recurrent or metastatic disease
No prior systemic therapy in the recurrent/metastatic setting
If prior adjuvant/definitive systemic therapy, more than 6 months have passed
Archived tumour tissue, or willing to undergo pretreatment biopsy
Measurable disease by RECIST 1.1 (assessed by the study team)
ECOG performance status 0 or 1
Disease suitable for curative-intent local therapy
Prior anti-TGFβ therapy
Prior anti-EGFR antibody therapy
Grade 2 or worse intolerance to anti-EGFR therapy or murine proteins
Immune checkpoint inhibitor completed within 6 months
Progression within 6 months of curative-intent systemic therapy
Life expectancy under 3 months
Active CNS metastases, cord compression, or leptomeningeal disease
Active major bleeding, or a major bleed within 4 weeks
Another investigational drug within 4 weeks or 5 half-lives
Active autoimmune disease requiring systemic treatment in the past 2 years
Active hepatitis B not on suppressive antiviral therapy
Hepatitis C not cured, or still detectable
Known HIV
Transplant requiring immunosuppression
Another malignancy within 2 years (with stated exceptions)
Systemic corticosteroids above 10 mg prednisone, or other immunosuppressants, within 7 days
Live or live-attenuated vaccine within 4 weeks
